items.title: Liquid Glass, Your Way
items.subtitle: Switch to the classic look under Interface → Appearance, or shrink the tab bar into a small pill as you scroll.

items.title: Fewer Rate Limits
items.subtitle: API-Key-Free accounts send fewer Reddit requests, and the new Reduce Rate Limiting setting cuts them further.

items.title: Subreddit Switcher
items.subtitle: Tap a feed's title for a native sheet with search, your favorites, and live results.

items.title: True Black Keyboard
items.subtitle: Make the keyboard pure black on OLED screens, in dark mode, light mode, or always.

items.title: Update Alerts
items.subtitle: Apollo Reborn now lets you know when an update is out and hands it to your sideloader.

items.title: X Links on Nitter
items.subtitle: Open X and Twitter links on a Nitter instance you choose, no X account needed.

items.title: Search With Kagi
items.subtitle: Kagi subscribers can search Reddit through Kagi from the Search tab's magnifier.

items.title: Profiles
items.subtitle: Edit your Reddit profile right in Apollo, and find profile settings on a new User Profiles page.

items.title: Fixes Across the App
items.subtitle: Crash fixes, Google and Apple sign-in, moderator tools without an API key, and no forced YouTube captions on iOS 27.
